requirements.text: Second parallel loop AUTHORIZED as a TRIAL (two loops total, never more without a new owner decision) under full isolation: the second supervisor instance runs with its own runtime identity (a distinct --checkout so it derives its own lock, journal, and audit chain), its own task worktree and branch, and a packet whose file scope is DISJOINT from every other live loop packet - the orchestrator verifies zero allowed_paths overlap before launch. Integration stays sequential: the orchestrator merges each loop's finished work one at a time at seams (ADR-005 unchanged).
requirements.required_harness: Second instance up with its own lock/journal/audit; overlap check recorded in the packet G0; both loops running concurrently without cross-writes.
requirements.required_evidence: launcher-2 + runtime state dirs + G0 report overlap statement

requirements.text: Loop-2 lane (owner choice): the context-panel parity increment (DB-016) - surface the already-fetched designations (zoning districts, commercial overlays, special districts, landmark/historic flags) with provenance and the validated ZoLa link alongside the computed answers in the architect flow; fold in the DB-005 ZoLa-link unification on the same surface (route every ZoLa link through the shared validated helper). Label display only - no new computation, no new data source; the computed-answer engine remains the differentiator.
requirements.required_harness: A contracted ledger task carries this scope and cites this requirement.
requirements.required_evidence: the loop-2 task packet + its gate reports

requirements.text: Trial safeguards: during the first day of dual-loop operation the orchestrator watches machine contention (slowed/timed-out units, starving checks) and account usage, reports problems to the owner in plain language, and drops back to ONE loop on sustained contention rather than letting both degrade. A third loop requires a new owner decision.
requirements.required_harness: Watcher coverage over both runs; a dated observation note at the first seam after dual operation begins.

requirements.text: Prohibition: the 3D lane stays under the expansion-planning hold (expansion-agent hold notice section 2). Neither loop receives a 3D massing packet unless the owner lifts that hold; this directive does not touch the hold.
requirements.required_harness: No 3D-scoped packet exists for either loop while the hold stands.
